name: Branch Quote to Bind API
description: A GraphQL API that enables partner platforms to embed Branch home and auto insurance quoting, binding, and policy management into their own workflows. The API covers the full insurance lifecycle from initial quote generation through policy purchase and document retrieval.

availableChannel.name: Staging GraphQL Endpoint
availableChannel.description: Staging environment for testing the Branch Quote to Bind API

availableChannel.name: GraphQL Schema Reference
availableChannel.description: Apollo GraphOS Studio schema reference for the Branch Quote to Bind API

availableChannel.name: GraphQL Playground
availableChannel.description: Interactive GraphQL explorer for the Branch Quote to Bind API

featureList: requestQuoteV2 - Initial quote generation for home and auto insurance
recalculateQuoteV2 - Modify existing quotes with updated information
addCar - Add a vehicle to an existing insurance quote
addDriver - Add a driver to an existing insurance quote
requestBind - Complete the insurance purchase and bind the policy
getOffer - Retrieve a previously created insurance offer by ID
getBoundPoliciesByOfferId - Retrieve bound policy details after purchase
getPolicyDocuments - Access policy documents (URLs valid for 15 minutes)
getOfferPDF - Generate downloadable offer PDFs (expires in 15 minutes)
